title: Bring in ’Da Noise, Bring in ’Da Funk / Dark tap poster

location.series: Pentagram / The Public Theater case study

slide_intent: Turn a physical detail into a focal point because a small object can stand for the experience of a performance.
strategic_value: A tap sole encircled by reviews can keep the campaign tied to dance while introducing a new visual treatment.
demonstration: A white tap-shoe sole sits on black, surrounded by radiating hand-lettered praise and red-outlined title words.
practical_value: Compare radial lettering around a central object with the dancer-led composition in PT13.

content_islands.name: Central sole
content_islands.spec: Place the tall tap sole in the middle.

content_islands.name: Radial reviews
content_islands.spec: Radiate praise and title fragments around it, with award and booking information at the base.
